message: Command `curl -sL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GNOME/libxml2/master/HTMLparser.c" -o /tmp/HTMLparser_current.c 2>&1 && wc -l /tmp/HTMLparser_current.c && grep -n "htmlParseSystemLiteral" /tmp/HTMLparser_current.c | head -5` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now I understand the fuzz harness. The input format is:
1. 4 bytes: options (int)
2. 4 bytes: maxAlloc (int)
3. Remaining: HTML document buffer

The HTML document is parsed with `htmlReadMemory` (pull parser) and also with a push parser. The vulnerability is in `htmlParseSystemLiteral`/`htmlParsePubidLiteral` which are called during DOCTYPE parsing.

Now let me understand the actual vulnerability. The key issue is that `len` is `size_t` but `xmlStrndup` takes `int`. Let me look at the fix for this. Let me check the current version of the code on GitHub.
